name: CCL Products (India) Ltd
title: CCL Products (India) Ltd - 519600 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 volume growth 18–20% with utilisation ~65% annual (70% in Q4) and no big capex for two years; FY27 guided to ~15% volume and EBITDA growth, with net debt cut by over ₹750 crores.

utilisation.quote: annually, we have with everything put together, new old, everything put together, we are approximately 65% capacity utilization

capex.peers_comment: Mgmt said Indian players are gaining global share and peers guide strong volume growth (analyst remark); no mgmt comment on peer capacity.
capex.quote: There is no planned big capex -- planned as of now for the next 2 years

triggers.label: Utilisation 65% → 72–73% FY27
triggers.quote: 65% will go to around 72%, 73%, If I were to be very specific.

triggers.label: No big capex next 2 years
triggers.quote: There is no planned big capex -- planned as of now for the next 2 years

triggers.label: FY27 volume and EBITDA ~15%
triggers.quote: we are sticking to the volume growth guidance of 15% and the resultant EBITDA growth will also be in the same region.

triggers.label: Q4 revenue +46% from coffee pass-through
triggers.quote: another 20%-25% of coffee prices increase that gets built into top line

triggers.label: Long-term contracts emerging
triggers.quote: we are seeing a lot of long-term contracts. In fact, some of our freeze-dried capacity is quite long-term now.

guidance.quote: we are sticking to the volume growth guidance of 15%
we are giving a guidance that EBITDA also will grow in line with the volume growth, which is around sort of 15%.
probably INR1,100 crores, INR1,200 crores is the level that we probably could be seeing in the next year
maintenance capex of maybe INR25 crores to INR30 crores, INR35 crores
we are still committed to driving 25% kind of volume growth

prior_guidance_check.quote: our volume growth has been -- and I'm speaking on a little larger four quarter perspective has been in the range of 18%, 20% this year
EBITDA stands at INR741.38 crores as against INR563.54 crores, which is a growth of 32%
we have reduced it to INR1,080 crores, I think possibly around about that number

red_flags.label: Gross margin compressed on lower-margin CIF contracts
red_flags.quote: this quarter, we did a little bit of the proportion of lower margin contracts are higher

red_flags.label: Q4 EBITDA/kg reportedly down sequentially
red_flags.quote: probably this quarter was a little bit of a down considering the proportion of coffee that you sell

evasions.quote: there is no commitment as of now, but things that you spoke about, most of the things we are thinking about.
it is a little too premature to talk to.
I don't think so we are giving guidance of lowering of inventory cycles from here on.
